items.text: Dear Stylists,

Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 "Tales Woven in Time" has begun. In order to provide a better gaming experience, we will continue to optimize, adjust, and fix issues in the game. Thank you for your understanding and support. We wish you a pleasant journey in Miraland!
■ November 12, 2026 Updates
★ Fixed Issues ★
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the DIY Workshop interface froze unexpectedly.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the bottom "Vanishing Spring" displayed incorrectly when paired with the shoes "Dustbound Wilderness".

● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the interaction failed to take effect as intended when collecting Gift-Giving Wild Birds in the "Adventure Among Stars" event because the interaction distance exceeded the allowed range. Stylists who were affected by this issue before the update and are missing the Gift-Giving Wild Bird collection rewards will receive the missing Diamond rewards during this maintenance.
● Fixed text translation errors.
■ November 6, 2026 Updates
★ Fixed Issues ★
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the dye effect on the dress "That Flamelight: Wishbound" was incorrect.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, interactions with the decorations "Across Time" and "Journey in a Suitcase" behaved incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, exchange points were displayed incorrectly in the Exchange Rankings of the "Mira Building Open Day" event.

● Fixed an issue where, in the "Mira Building Open Day" event, when one of the exchange projects in the Challenge Zone had already reached full progress, entering that exchange project did not correctly notify the stylist that exchange progress was full.
● Fixed an issue where the dress "Unsleeping Miracle" displayed incorrectly.
● Fixed some text and translation errors.

● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, collecting Gift-Giving Wild Birds in Stages 4 and 5 of the "Adventure Among Stars" event incorrectly showed that no rewards had been received. Verification confirmed that the rewards had been received as normal and that stage progress is unaffected.

● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, Gift-Giving Wild Birds could be collected repeatedly in Stages 1 and 2 of the "Adventure Among Stars" event, granting duplicate rewards. Stylists who received duplicate rewards before the fix will have the extra Diamonds deducted in a later update.

◆ We sincerely apologize for the issues in the "Adventure Among Stars" event. After this announcement, we will send Diamond *50 to all stylists as compensation. Please claim it from your in-game mail.
■ November 3, 2026 Updates
★ Fixed Issues ★
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the effective range of the Momo Fishing ability was incorrect.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, using the bow "Firmament Echoes" on mobile devices caused the game to crash.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the outerwear "Spring on Shoulder" displayed incorrect colors after using certain abilities on mobile devices.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the "Cheese's Edge: Whimsicality" ability behaved incorrectly when a custom outfit was configured for it.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, some Dews of Inspiration could not be collected on mobile devices.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the sound effects in the "Mira Building Open Day" event were incorrect.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the order of the Friend Assist list in the "Mira Building Open Day" event was displayed incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where interactions with the decoration "Symphony Fountain" behaved incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where the furniture "Styling Stage" and "Blossoming Fragrance Display Stand" displayed incorrectly when showing certain dress pieces.
● Fixed an issue where, after using the "Default: Shrinking" ability, the settlement page for "Fashion Detectives, Assemble!" in the Mira Building Open Day event displayed incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where the model of the bottom "Roaming in the Woods" and its Glow Up pieces displayed incorrectly when paired with certain top and outerwear pieces.
● Fixed an issue where the model of the outerwear "Lightwoven Passage" and its Evolution and Glow Up pieces displayed incorrectly when paired with certain dress pieces.
● Fixed an issue where the Dyeing Schemes of the included pieces were not saved along with the styling scheme when using the View Outfit feature on the photo details page.
● Fixed some text and translation errors.
■ November 2, 2026 Updates
★ Fixed Issues ★
● Fixed an issue where the world quest "Rewind: Across Time and Space" could not progress as intended.
● Fixed an issue where the outerwear "History & Present" displayed incorrect colors.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, dialogue behaved incorrectly when manually advanced on mobile devices.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the ability "Star Fishing" could not be used as intended to collect Meteorites in Home.
■ October 31, 2026 Updates
★ Fixed Issues ★
● Fixed an issue where tracking for the world quest \[She Who Was Never Written] behaved incorrectly.

● Fixed an issue where progress was displayed incorrectly after collecting Gift-Giving Wild Birds in the "Adventure Among Stars" event. This issue did not affect the actual rewards received. Stylists who had completed the collection before the update will have their progress corrected within 3 working days.
● Fixed an issue where, on certain mobile devices, scenes in the "Dust-Sealed Storybook" were displayed incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where, on certain mobile devices, the main quest \[Reunion with Yesterday] could not progress while in the target "Meditate near the Great Lumie Tree."
● Fixed an issue where the button displayed for claiming achievement rewards in the event "Miracle Building Open Day" did not match the actual button in controller mode.
● Fixed an issue where switching palettes while Dyeing the pieces caused lag in controller mode.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, distortion and flickering may appear after completing the exclusive quest \[The Snow Remembers].
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the ability Flourish Walk cannot be used properly in the Home.
● Fixed an issue where Wilhelm's model would unexpectedly disappear under certain circumstances.
● Fixed an issue where models may appear abnormally when pairing the top "Dream Between Pages" and the bottom "Vanishing Spring" with certain clothing pieces.
● Fixed an issue where outfits would switch incorrectly when using the ability "Unmelting Snow" while riding.
● Fixed an issue where the piece details and sketch descriptions of "Threads of Reunion: Makeup" displayed abnormally.
● Fixed some text and translation errors.
■ October 30, 2026 Update
★ Fixed Issues ★
● Fixed the presentation of certain story cinematics in the main quest "Reunion with Yesterday."
● Fixed an issue where the option to download to the local photo library was missing from the photo viewer on mobile devices.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the "Threads of Reunion" outfit displayed incorrectly on the display stand during a story dialogue in the main quest "Reunion with Yesterday."
● Fixed an issue where the settlement page for "Fashion Detectives, Assemble!" in the Mira Building Open Day event displayed incorrectly.
● Fixed text translation errors.

Dear Stylists,
Infinity Nikki will undergo a version update from 12:50 to 20:00 on October 29, 2026 (UTC-7). During this period, the game will be inaccessible. Please plan to avoid any unnecessary losses.
Pre-download for the upcoming update has opened on October 28, 2026, at 03:00 (UTC-7). Stylists can download partial resources in advance, enabling faster access to the game post-maintenance.
The maintenance schedule may be adjusted based on actual conditions. Details of this update can be found below. We appreciate your understanding and support!

◆ The limited-time Resonance events "Gilded Judgment," "Palette of Destiny," "The Unfading Wanderer," and "Till the Night Ends" will end on October 29 at 12:49 (UTC-7). Please remember to claim your rewards in \[Deep Echoes] in time.
◆ The event pages for "Fun to Play," "Time to Collect," "Justice in Golden Light," "Alison's Travel Shop," and "Starlight Contest" will close on October 29 at 12:49 (UTC-7).

◆ The store sections "Autumn Dreamweave," "The Rose's Heart," "Tide Echo," "Golden Glow Momo," "Memory Hall," and "Tidal Song" will close on October 29 at 12:49 (UTC-7). The outfits "Neon Heartbeat," "Riverside Sunshine," "Lotus Fate," and "Daisy Murmurs" will also be removed from Store > Clothing on October 29 at 12:49 (UTC-7).
★ Adjustments ★

Version 3.0 brings a large amount of new content. After careful evaluation, we plan to begin the server maintenance earlier than scheduled to ensure a more stable experience for our stylists. The Version 3.0 maintenance time is adjusted to November 26, 10:30 to 20:00 (UTC-7).

Compensation for the server downtime during the Version 3.0 update will include an additional 300 Diamonds in addition to the regular maintenance compensation, bringing the total compensation to 600 Diamonds and 1 Resonite Crystal. These will be sent via in-game mail after the version update. We appreciate your understanding and support!

In addition, due to the adjusted maintenance time, the end times of certain previously announced events need to be adjusted. Please plan your playtime accordingly so you do not miss out on events and rewards.

◆ The Little Prince limited-time collaboration event "For the Child You Once Were" will end on November 26 at 10:29 (UTC-7). Please remember to accept the exclusive quest "For the Child You Once Were" in time.

◆ The collab-limited Resonance "A Story Dedicated to Children" will end on November 26 at 10:29 (UTC-7). Please remember to claim your rewards in \[Deep Echoes] in time. The Resonance item Cherished Rose will be automatically converted into Resonite Crystals at a 1:1 ratio after Version 2.11 ends.

◆ The limited-time events "Tales of Itzaland I," "Tales of Itzaland II," "Tales of Itzaland III," "Build on the Land I," "Build on the Land II," and "Face It! Wild Surge Returns" will end on November 26 at 10:29 (UTC-7).
★ Maintenance Duration ★
October 29, 12:50 to 20:00 (UTC-7)
★ Compensation ★
Diamond *300, Resonite Crystal *1
Available only to stylists who log in and unlock the inbox feature before 08:59 on November 6 (UTC-7).
★ Pre-Download Guide ★
Pre-Download Period: October 28, 03:00 – October 29, 12:49 (UTC-7)
■ Pre-Download Methods
Method 1: Tap the \[Pre-download Resource Pack] icon in the lower-right corner of the in-game login screen to begin.
Method 2: Navigate to \[Settings > Other] in-game and tap \[Pre-download Resource Pack] to begin.
>> During mobile pre-download, stylists cannot access gameplay. Please schedule your download accordingly. Completing the pre-download allows faster entry after the Version 2.11 maintenance.
Open the launcher and click the \[Pre-Download] icon displayed on the \[Start Game] button.

>> Stylists must complete the prerequisite game version update via the launcher. The \[Pre-Download] option will appear only after the \[Start Game] button becomes available. During PC pre-download, you may play the current version as usual.
Method 1: Tap the \[Pre-download Resource Pack] icon in the lower-right corner of the in-game login screen to begin.
Method 2: Navigate to \[Settings > Other] in-game and tap \[Pre-download Resource Pack] to begin.
>> During pre-download, stylists cannot access gameplay. Please schedule your download accordingly. Completing the pre-download allows faster entry after the Version 2.11 maintenance.
★ New Content ★
■ Limited-Time Exclusive Quest: The Snow Remembers

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), the quest unlocks after completing Chapter 2 of the Itzaland main storyline. Complete the exclusive quest to earn Resonite Crystals, Diamonds, the earring sketches "To Friendship" and "To Encounter," growth materials, and more. After completing the quest, you can claim the limited card "Page of Falling Snow" and additional Diamond rewards on the event page.
■ Permanent Main Quest: Reunion with Yesterday

After the Version 2.11 update, the new main storyline "Reunion with Yesterday" unlocks. Complete the "Reunion with Yesterday" main quest to earn Resonite Crystals, growth materials, and more. Complete tasks while the Events interface task page is open to receive additional rewards such as Diamonds. Complete the main quest "Reunion with Yesterday" to unlock a special mystery reward.
In addition, you can also complete special limited-time events during Version 2.11 to claim Resonite Crystals, Energy Crystals, and growth materials.
■ Limited-Time Check-in Event: As the Pages Unfold

From the Version 2.11 update until November 12, 18:59 (UTC-7), log in daily to claim rewards. Log in for 7 days to claim all the rewards, for a total of 10 Revelation Crystals. The rewards refresh daily at 04:00.
■ The "Fun to Play" Events
● Limited-Time World and Random Quest Event: Snow-Covered Tales

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), stylists can complete world quests in "Winter Prologue" and random quests in "Snowlit Encounters" to earn Diamonds, the top "Pikas' Wishes," growth materials, and more.
● Limited-Time Event: Touring Sleigh

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), this event unlocks after progressing the exclusive quest "The Snow Remembers." During the event, stylists can head to Snowgrove and ride the Touring Sleigh, enjoying the town's winter scenery on a relaxing tour and earning Diamond rewards.
◆ Snowgrove can be reached via the limited-time teleport point opened in Elderwood Forest.
■ The "Time to Collect" Events
● Limited-Time Event: Snowborne Sprigs

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), 4 tasks will be unlocked at a time. Complete these tasks to earn Wish Snowflakes. Collect enough Wish Snowflakes to exchange for rewards, including the 3-star outfit Frostwish Sprout, Diamonds, growth materials, and more.
■ Limited-Time Resonance: Snowfall, Softly Sung

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), stylists can use Revelation Crystals, Frostwish Exclusive Revelation Gems, or Limited-Time Revelation Crystals to resonate and obtain the new 5-star outfit "Snowbloom Wishsong" and the 4-star outfit "Cheese and Sword."
● Complete the 5-Star Outfit "Snowbloom Wishsong" to Unlock the Following
Unmelting Snow: After using the ability, Nikki glides gracefully with light, nimble steps. As she spins and leaps, snow begins to fall quietly all around her.

Nikki can summon a gingerbread helper to aid her on her journey. The gingerbread helper can fish, catch bugs, groom, and collect within a certain range around Nikki. Animals and bugs won't be scared away when they approach. Once they are summoned, she can switch between gingerbread helpers with different specialties. When Nikki switches to another ability, the gingerbread helper won't disappear.

There are four gingerbread helpers who prioritize their specialty, collecting preferred resources within range before moving on to others: strawberry excels at fishing, butter at bug-catching, chocolate at grooming, and matcha at collecting items. They will collect their preferred resources and return to Nikki when they finish collecting.
◆ Unmelting Snow cannot be used in indoor stages.
● Evolution Rewards of the 5-Star Outfit "Snowbloom Wishsong"

>> Evolving the outfit to Stage 2 unlocks the Framed Moment item "Snowy Wishes" and \[Decoration: Radiance] on the Evolution Stage 2 screen. Firstwish Heartchime: Wishful Sweetness can be used in \[Decoration: Radiance] to obtain the decoration "Wishful Sweetness: Radiance," which can be placed in open spaces for photography and display.
>> Evolving the outfit to Stage 3 unlocks "Wishfall Heart: Makeup," enhanced special effects, a new idle animation, and alternative details for certain pieces.
● Resonance Milestone Rewards
Based on your number of Resonance attempts in "Snowfall, Softly Sung," you can earn rewards such as "Snowbloom Wishsong: Makeup," "Momo's Cloak: Carol," and the decoration "Wishful Sweetness."
>> Reach 160 Resonance attempts in "Snowfall, Softly Sung" to claim the decoration "Wishful Sweetness," which can be placed in open spaces for photography and display.

>> Reach 230 Resonance attempts in "Snowfall, Softly Sung" to claim the Ocean's Glowing Gift Box, which includes the item "Heartshine: Snowbloom Wishsong" and the Radiance material "Firstwish Heartchime: Wishful Sweetness."
● Complete the 4-Star Outfit "Cheese and Sword" to Unlock the Following

Cheese's Edge: Whimsicality: After using the ability, Nikki raises her rapier and deftly catches a falling piece of cheese. The golden cheese settles on the tip of her blade, glowing with a soft radiance.
■ Rerun Resonance: Flight to Freedom

From the Version 2.11 update until November 12, 18:59 (UTC-7), stylists can use Revelation Crystals, Frostwish Exclusive Revelation Gems, Limited-Time Revelation Crystals, or Epiphany Crystals to resonate in "Flight to Freedom" and obtain the 4-star outfit "Gilded Memories."
● Complete the 4-Star Outfit "Gilded Memories" to Unlock the Following
Golden Plume: Whimsicality: After using the ability, Nikki will summon two birds crowned in gold to accompany her on her journey.
■ Rerun Resonance: Daydream Weaver

From the Version 2.11 update until November 12, 18:59 (UTC-7), stylists can use Revelation Crystals, Frostwish Exclusive Revelation Gems, Limited-Time Revelation Crystals, or Epiphany Crystals to resonate in "Daydream Weaver" and obtain the 4-star outfit "Cloud Daydreams."
● Complete the 4-Star Outfit "Cloud Daydreams" to Unlock the Following

Dreamy Clouds: Whimsicality: After Nikki uses the ability, Nikki's daydreams take shape as playful clouds. Cheerful ponies, fluffy cotton candy rings, and cuddly chubby bears join her in frolicking, bringing the magic of imagination to life!
■ Limited-Time Collab Event: Adventure Among Stars

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), this event unlocks after progressing through the collab-exclusive quest "For the Child You Once Were." During the event, stylists can venture into the starry skies beyond the story, follow the starlight on a journey, and begin a wondrous adventure to earn Diamonds, growth materials, and more.
◆ "Adventure Among Stars" is a limited-time event that will end with Version 2.11.
■ Limited-Time Event: Mira Building Open Day

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), stylists can take part in Mira Building Open Day, try a variety of fun exchange projects, and set off on a wondrous visit unlike any other.
1. How to Play

During the event, open the Mira Building Open Day page in Current Adventures and complete the Miraland Journey Review to unlock exploration of the rooms in Mira Building; reach certain exploration milestones to earn event rewards.
The event is divided into three phases. There are 23 floors in Mira Building, and as the event progresses, new rooms and floors will gradually unlock:
(1) Phase 1: Opens after the Version 2.11 update, unlocking floors 1 – 10 of Mira Building.
(2) Phase 2: Opens on November 5, 2026, at 05:00 (UTC-7), unlocking floors 11 – 15 of Mira Building.
(3) Phase 3: Opens on November 13, 2026, at 05:00 (UTC-7), unlocking floors 11 – 23 of Mira Building.
2. Miraland Journey Recap

When you enter the event for the first time, the Miraland Journey Recap will begin. Based on your past journey data, it will generate an event-exclusive ability rating and grant the matching event title. Event titles are only displayed on the in-event rankings and are only valid during the event.
Note: The Miraland Journey Recap only counts play data from before the event began; different ability ratings provide different exchange point bonuses for exchange projects
3. Room Details
(1) Rules
There are 7 types of rooms in Mira Building: the Casual Zone, Challenge Zone, Supply Zone, Surprise Room, Archive Room, Hub Control Room, and Lighting Control Room.

There are exchange projects in the Casual Zone, Challenge Zone, Hub Control Room, and Lighting Control Room. Exchange attempts allow you to take part in these exchange projects and increase the room's exchange progress; once the overall progress reaches its target, the room's exchange will be completed, and new rooms connected by pathways will open.
Stylists are free to choose their own route forward and can return at any time to rooms with completed exchanges to explore new routes.
(2) The Rooms
>> Casual Zone: Complete the exchange project to move forward.
>> Challenge Zone: Complete the 2 exchange projects in this room to move forward.
>> Supply Zone: Once accessible, it provides exchange items or an overall exchange point bonus, with no exchange project to complete.

>> Surprise Room: There are souvenirs hidden around the room. Once accessible, claim rewards such as Diamonds, the limited title "Mira Building Special Guest," and growth materials, with no exchange project to complete.

>> Archive Room: The room holds tidbit clues. Once it opens, the collected tidbits can then be browsed, and comments can be posted to interact with other stylists, with no exchange project to complete. Torn pages lie scattered everywhere. Piece them together, and you may uncover something new.
>> Hub Control Room: Opens in Phase 2. Complete the exchange project in this room to connect all pathways in this phase.
>> Lighting Control Room: Opens in Phase 3. Complete the exchange project in this room to dispel the mist covering the other areas of this exchange phase.
4. Exchange Project Details

The exchange projects include "Ready, Set, Snap!" "Code, Connect, Launch!" and "Fashion Detectives, Assemble!" During the event, 3 exchange attempts are granted daily at 04:00 (Server Time), and unused attempts carry over and can be used at any time before the event ends.
(1) Exchange Projects
>> "Ready, Set, Snap!": Catch Mira Building staff on camera within the time limit, capture their best moments, and aim for a higher score!
>> "Code, Connect, Launch!": Complete the circuit connections within the time limit, collect dev keys, and get the in-development game running! The more keys you collect, the more Dev Heat you earn.
>> "Fashion Detectives, Assemble!": Work from the styling Impression Clues left by master stylists, deduce the perfect outfit in everyone's heart, and trade styling insights with them!
(2) Rules

>> When joining exchange projects, stylists can also invite friends to assist. You get an assist Exchange point bonus based on your friend's Ability Level. You can invite up to 3 friends per exchange, and the same friend up to 2 times per day.
>> Some Supply Zones offer an Overall Exchange Point Bonus, which can be viewed under "Shared Bonus."

>> Each exchange project has matching exchange items that simplify gameplay. They can be obtained from Supply Zones, come with a usage cap per exchange, and the uses are restored once the exchange ends.

>> Rooms with exchange projects have Exchange Rankings showing the exchange point standings for the projects inside, split into Overall Exchange Points and Friend Exchange Points rankings. Select "Open Day Exchange Rankings" on the main event page to view the total exchange point standings for each of the three exchange projects, likewise split into Overall Exchange Points and Friend Exchange Points rankings.
>> Rooms with completed exchanges can still be accessed. Exchange points earned then count only toward Personal Achievements, no longer adding to the Overall Exchange Points progress or the rankings.
5. Mira Building Employee Challenge
During the event, at 12:00 and 18:00 daily (Server Time), an employee will appear in Mira Building for all stylists to challenge together.
Each session lasts 30 minutes. Stylists have 1 attempt to earn Challenge Points, which count toward the Overall Challenge Points.
Each challenge you take part in grants 1 extra exchange project attempt, and unused attempts carry over.
6. Event Rewards
Complete any exchange project to earn Diamonds on the Mira Building Open Day page in Current Adventures; you can also earn the following achievement rewards by participating in the event:

Overall Achievements: Once the overall progress meets the required conditions, claim rewards such as Diamonds, the decoration "Dreams in Mira Building," the pose "Proud & Dashing," "Momo's Pose: Bouncing with Joy," and growth materials.
Personal Achievements: Once your personal progress meets the required conditions, claim rewards such as Diamonds, the limited title "Speed Is Power," and growth materials.
■ Event: The Sovereign of Sweet Returns

After the Version 2.11 update, this event becomes permanently available after completing the world quest "The Sovereign Descends! Golden Age Style!" Complete Sovereign challenges to earn the Collage Poster "Sweetheart Stripes," Resonite Crystals, growth materials, and more.

◆ The event page is only displayed during Version 2.11. "The Sovereign of Sweet Returns" is permanently available. After the page closes, stylists can still head to Itzaland to continue the experience.

Stylists can submit entries based on the current theme and vote for their favorite works in the Color Lookbook. Complete tasks to earn Diamonds, Upgrade Packs, and more.

Spend 180 Diamonds to obtain the headwear "Snowy Magical Night" and "Momo's Cloak: Winternight Gift"!
● "Footnotes of Time" Open for a Limited Time

From the Version 2.11 update until November 26, 10:29 (UTC-7), you can claim 1 free resource reward on the "Snowfall's Chapter" interface. On this interface, each pack purchase comes with generous free rewards. Unlock more packs to enjoy even more great offers!

>> On your first real-money purchase, you'll receive Revelation Crystal *1 and Bling *10,000, along with these free rewards: Shining Particle *5, Thread of Purity *10, Shiny Bubbles *30, Luminous Prism *10, and Bling *10,000.

● Complete the 5-Star Outfit Florabound Promise to Unlock the Following

Sylvan Glow: After using the ability, Nikki channels the life force flowing through the forest and enters the Forest Radiance state. This state remains active until logout or until the ability is manually disabled.

After equipping Sylvan Glow, Nikki can consume energy to draw nearby creatures toward her, continuously attracting insects in the surrounding area. Once enabled, the attraction effect remains active until logout or until the ability is manually disabled. Attracted insects manifest as forest butterflies that follow Nikki. Each butterfly can carry 5 insects, and up to 6 butterflies can exist at once. Another outfit ability can then be used to catch those following insects. In Co-op, you cannot see or catch other stylists' forest butterflies.

While in the Forest Radiance state, its energy can be used to power regional abilities in Itzaland. When using the outfit abilities Default: Gigantification, Dawn Stroll: Sticky Claw, Default: Machine Control, or Skystride Dragon Statue, Forest Radiance energy is automatically consumed once the original energy is depleted, allowing the effect to continue.
When in the Forest Radiance state, energy regenerates automatically over time and can also be replenished by collecting Blings.
Note: The ability Sylvan Glow cannot be used in certain stages or in the Mira Crown Merit Arena.

Dear Stylists,

Infinity Nikki Version 2.8 "Golden Dust" has begun. In order to provide a better gaming experience, we will continue to optimize, adjust, and fix issues in the game. Thank you for your understanding and support. We wish you a pleasant journey in Miraland!

★ Optimizations ★
■ Clothing Optimizations
● Wardrobe Preview Upgrade: Open-World Scene Preview Added

An open-world scene preview feature has been added for custom outfit styling. After the Version 2.8 update, in custom styling interfaces such as \, \[DIY Workshop], and \[Cycling Outfit], select the \[Scene Preview] button on the left to view the current outfit in an open-world scene. The preview location will be Nikki's current location. In \[Scene Preview], you can move the camera, adjust the direction Nikki is facing, and view the outfit under four different lighting conditions.
● Clothing Piece Special Effect Toggle Added

A special effect toggle has been added for clothing pieces. After the Version 2.8 update, in custom styling interfaces such as \, \[DIY Workshop], and \[Cycling Outfit], clothing pieces with special effects will have a special indicator. You can use \[Effect Toggle] in the lower-right corner to directly show or hide effects. Select the \[Clothing Effect Settings] button on the left to quickly manage effect toggles for clothing pieces with the special effect indicator.

◆ \[Effect Toggle] does not apply to makeup. In \[DIY Workshop], schemes with hidden effects can be uploaded. In the Color Lookbook, work details will also show whether piece effects are hidden, and imported styling schemes will automatically inherit the effect toggle state.

An Import button has been added to \[Ability Outfit Setup > Customize Outfit]. After the Version 2.8 update, you can select custom schemes from \ on the \[Import Styling Scheme] interface to import them. If an imported scheme contains unavailable pieces, those pieces will be marked as unavailable in the clothing list, making them easier to find and replace.

After the Version 2.8 update, when using the \[Gilded Dawnchaser: Mount] or \[Unicorn's Vow: Mount] ability, open \ to set custom styling for Mount Mode. ■ PC and Mobile Storage Optimization

After the Version 2.8 update, stylists on PC and mobile can go to \[Settings > Features] and use \[Event Map Resource Management] and \[Clear History Quest Resources] to delete redundant resources as needed. Up to 12.8 GB can be cleared on PC, and up to 5.4 GB can be cleared on mobile. This optimization is related to in-game quest completion, so the amount of resources that can be cleared will vary by stylist.
In future versions, we will continue to pursue more comprehensive storage optimizations to provide stylists with a lighter, more streamlined gaming experience!

\[Event Map Resource Management] can be used to delete and download resources related to \[Firework Isles], \[Serenity Island], \[Danqing Island], and \[Wanxiang Realm]. ● Limited-Time Event: \[Pick Your Dream Stage]

From the Version 2.7 update until July 16, 12:49 (UTC-7), the stage styles \[Bubble Rush] and \[Firework Fantasy] will be available. Stylists can head to the Music Spaces to earn Heartstrings by collecting \[Radiant Stars] and \[Drift Stars] and taking part in activities there. Infusing Heartstrings into either stage style converts them into Supports for that specific stage style. The two stage styles will compete across phases. After each phase, the Sea of Stars Stage will switch to the stage style with the highest Supports.
>> Event Phase Details

The competition is divided into 3 phases, with 5 rounds in each phase: Each round is settled daily at 05:00 (UTC-7). The winning stage style earns match points: 1 point for each win in Rounds 1, 2, and 3, and 2 points for each win in Rounds 4 and 5. Once a phase enters the Settlement Period, voting will be paused. The stage style with the higher total number of match points in that phase wins the phase. After each phase's settlement ends, the \[Sea of Stars Stage] will switch to the stage appearance of the winning stage style. Before each round begins, Supports for all stage styles will be reset, but Heartstrings will not.
1. Phase I
Voting Period: From the Version 2.7 update until June 28, 04:59 (UTC-7). You can use Heartstrings to vote for your preferred stage style.

Settlement Period: June 28, 05:00 – June 30, 04:59 (UTC-7). During this period, the winning stage style will be displayed in the Starshine Stage area. If \[Bubble Rush] wins, bubble decorations will be added to the stage. If \[Firework Fantasy] wins, firework decorations will be added to the stage.
2. Phase II
Voting Period: June 30, 05:00 – July 5, 04:59 (UTC-7). You can use Heartstrings to vote for your preferred stage style.

Settlement Period: July 5, 05:00 – July 7, 04:59 (UTC-7). During this period, the winning stage style will be displayed in the Starshine Stage area. If \[Bubble Rush] wins, ice cream carts will be added around the stage. If \[Firework Fantasy] wins, skewer carts will be added around the stage.
3. Phase III
Voting Period: July 7, 05:00 – July 12, 04:59 (UTC-7). You can use Heartstrings to vote for your preferred stage style.

Settlement Period: July 12, 05:00 – July 16, 12:49 (UTC-7). During this period, the winning stage style will be displayed in the Starshine Stage area. If \[Bubble Rush] wins, the stage music will change to a melodious style. If \[Firework Fantasy] wins, the stage music will change to a dynamic, rhythmic style.
>> Heartstring Details

During the event, the initial Heartstring cap is 4,000 on the first day. After the event begins, the cap increases by 2,000 at 05:00 (UTC-7) each day. Heartstrings will not be reset during the event. Accumulating a certain number of Heartstrings will unlock corresponding rewards.
1. Music Space: Bubbles

In the Rest Zone, use facilities such as the Bom-Bom Bubble Machine, chairs, and lighting console to earn Heartstrings. In the Heartbeat Zone, bubbles drift across the water, each carrying a Drift Star. Touch Drift Stars to earn plenty of Heartstrings.
2. Music Space: Fireworks

In the Rest Zone, set off Firework Sticks and Blazing Firecrackers, sit in chairs to watch the fireworks, or use the lighting console to earn Heartstrings. In the Heartbeat Zone, the Bouncy Drum and Rhythm Disc are the core gameplay features. Jump onto a Bouncy Drum to launch high into the air, while Rhythm Discs move or pause with the beat. Use them to collect Radiant Stars and earn plenty of Heartstrings.
3. Momo's Dance Camp in Music Space: Bubbles / Music Space: Fireworks

In the Bubbles or Fireworks Music Space, interact with unilluminated Momos and choose solo or co-op mode to start Momo's Dance Camp. After Nikki demonstrates the dance moves, use directional inputs to guide Momo through the performance. Heartstrings are awarded based on your score at the end of the performance, and placing first in co-op grants bonus Heartstrings. On different stages, Momo's dance moves and songs will vary.
4. Limited-Time Events
During the event, multiple special limited-time events will become available each day at random times. These include \[Striking Heartstrings], \[Shooting Star's Call], and \[Surprise Song].

When \[Striking Heartstrings] is active, small Drift Stars and small Radiant Stars in Music Space: Bubbles and Music Space: Fireworks will be replaced by large Drift Stars and large Radiant Stars. Touch them to earn a large amount of Heartstrings.

When \[Shooting Star's Call] is active, a meteor summoning area can be found in both Music Space: Bubbles and Music Space: Fireworks. Press and hold the Starbell button while inside the area to summon a shooting star. The shooting star will bestow a blessing upon Nikki, allowing her to keep obtaining Heartstrings while staying within the area.
When \[Surprise Song] is active, playing Momo's Dance Camp in the Surprise Song space grants double track score and Heartstrings, and unlocks special stage effects.
>> Gameplay Feature: \[Nikki's Music Club]

Head to Events to choose from different potential group members and record songs together. Saved songs will be recorded in the decoration \[Rhythm Blocks]. \[Rhythm Blocks] can be placed in the open world or in the \[Sea of Stars], and interacting with the decoration will play back the song.
◆ The song recorded in \[Rhythm Blocks] will always be the last version saved in \[Nikki's Music Club]. After the event ends, the song stored in \[Rhythm Blocks] can no longer be edited.

● Added a quick outfit change feature in Photo Mode
A new Wardrobe entry has been added to Momo's Camera, allowing stylists to quickly access the outfit change screen while taking photos to change outfits and Momo's Cloaks.
The saved content of Presets has also been optimized. Momo-related settings will now be saved together with the preset.
● Added popular display and sorting features for the \[Starlight Contest]
New tabs have been added to display Today's Trending, 3-Day Trending, and all-time Trending submissions.
A new sorting option has also been added, allowing submissions to be sorted by Recommended or Popularity.
The display of previously popular works has been improved, with a new popularity tag added.
A new capacity details button has been added under My Works.
■ Home Construction Experience Optimizations
● Added categorization and favorites to the Furniture List, and improved information display

A new All category has been added, allowing you to view all furniture under the current top-level category. Newly obtained furniture will now be displayed at the top of the list with a red dot notification.

The information display for Presets - Furniture Sets and Presets - Preset Houses has been improved. The number of currently placeable furniture combinations is now shown, and you can select a furniture combination to view the required items and quickly equip the current set or house to the shortcut bar.
The information display for Preset - Smart Brush has also been improved. Selecting a Smart Brush now shows the furniture categories required by that brush.

A new Favorite feature has been added for furniture, furniture combinations, and sets. Favorited entries will be pinned to the top of the current category for quicker searching and placement, with a maximum of 20 pinned entries.
● Added batch processing and quick deletion to the Placed List
A new Delete All feature has been added, allowing affected objects in the Placed List to be force-deleted quickly.

The item acquisition flow has been improved. \ and \[Claim All] have been merged into the new \[Batch Process] feature, allowing affected items to be quickly purchased or crafted. While processing these items, \[Dreamland Stones] can now be used to purchase furniture from both current and previous Dreamland Store lineups.

The \[Obtain - Craft] feature has been improved to support quickly adding items to the crafting queue, speeding up crafting, and claiming all straight away. For items that cannot be crafted but whose sketches can be obtained, the sketches can now also be acquired quickly.

The \[Obtain - Purchase] feature has also been improved. Obtainable and unobtainable items will now be displayed separately under \[Batch Process], and for items that can be purchased straight away, the required sketches can also be obtained quickly.
● Added custom schemes and multiple advanced settings to Construction Settings
A new \[Custom Scheme] feature has been added, supporting 4 custom schemes. Build settings used before the update will be saved to Custom Scheme 1 by default after the update.
Quick-use preset templates have been added for furniture, structure, and terrain editing settings.
A new \[Adjust Placement] option has been added, allowing precise adjustment of placement positions under a fixed camera angle.
A new \[Auto-correct Distance] option has been added. Placed furniture and structures will no longer shift when selected.
New \ options have been added for furniture, structures, and terrain. When turned off, objects in the corresponding category can no longer be selected during construction.
A new \[Continuous placement of inventory items] option has been added. If the current item is still in stock, placement will continue automatically until inventory runs out.
\[Enable Snapping] has been upgraded to \[Snap Settings], allowing you to choose the snap strength. Furniture now also supports snapping placement.
A new camera distance setting has been added, with near, medium, and far options.
● Improved Floral Construction and placement feedback

A new \[Hide Nikki in Floral Construction] option has been added. When the Floral Construction mode is activated, Nikki's model will be hidden and excluded from collision calculations, preventing it from affecting furniture placement.

The editing experience for Floral Paths in \[Floral Construction] mode has been improved. Move, copy, rotate, multi-select, and grouped selection functions have been added, and these can now also be included in Home Schemes and Group Schemes for sharing and importing.

Placement feedback for interactive furniture has also been improved. The game will now indicate whether an item can be interacted with based on its placement position. If the total number placed exceeds the available stock for that item, a pop-up notification will appear.

The save rules for dyeable furniture and structures have been improved. After placing dyed furniture or structures, the dye state will be recorded for the current construction session and shown with the corresponding icon in the Furniture List and shortcut bar.
Feedback when saving construction schemes has also been improved. If any objects are outside the construction area, a pop-up notification will appear, allowing you to quickly delete them.

A new time adjustment feature has been added to the Construction interface. When adjusting time, you can choose to lock the current time. Once selected, the time state in your Home will remain fixed for the duration of the current Construction Ability session.

items.text: 1) When \[Tidal Pulses] surpass the highest reward tier, you can repeatedly claim the limited-time item \[Tide's Murmurs], which can be exchanged for \[Tidefallen Treasures] rewards.

■ New Feature: \[Starlight Contest]
After the Version 2.5 update, the new feature \[Starlight Contest] will open. Stylists can submit entries based on the current theme and vote for their favorite works in the Color Lookbook.
● Availability Schedule
Each version of "Starlight Contest" will feature two different themes in the first and second halves of the period. Participate in the theme event to earn rewards such as \ and \[Upgrade Packs].
From the Version 2.5 update until May 10, 18:59 (UTC-7), Starlight Contest will feature the theme event "Tidal Requiem."
● Event Access
Enter through \[Current Adventures > Starlight Contest] or \[Color Lookbook > Starlight Contest].
● Event Rules
\[Starlight Contest] consists of three phases: submission, voting, and tallying.
>> Submission Phase

On the event interface, select \[Enter Contest] to upload qualifying works from \[Nikki's Album] that match the current theme and submit them for the contest. You can also take Snapshot works based on the theme, then press \ and select \[Submit Entry] to submit them. You may enter the current theme contest or replace a work from a previous theme.
Please note: If you choose a new work to replace a work that has already entered the contest, the votes it has received will be cleared.
>> Voting Phase

One day after the Submission Phase begins, the Voting Phase will start. During this phase, submissions and voting are both available. Press \[Vote Now] or \[Current Trending] to jump to the voting interface and vote for your favorite works. You can also vote for your favorite works via \[Color Lookbook > Shimmer Album] under the current theme.

After the current Starlight Contest begins, you will receive 10 votes. After that, whether you log in or not, you will receive 5 votes daily. Unused votes will be cleared when the current Starlight Contest ends.
>> Tallying Phase

During this phase, submissions, replacement of contest works, and voting will be unavailable. You can press \[My Works] to view your submitted works, and press \[Past Featured] to view popular works from previous events. The \[Current Trending] screen will display the top-ranking contest entries and the number of votes each work received.
■ New Event Theme for \[Mira Crown Merit Arena] Now Available
After the Version 2.5 update, "Mira Crown Merit Arena" will feature a new event theme, "Echoes of Tides," and stylists may freely choose from the available event themes to enter.
From the Version 2.5 update until May 28, 12:49 (UTC-7), participate in the limited-time "Mira Crown Merit Arena" event to earn \.
● Availability Schedule
The "Echoes of Tides" theme includes 7 arenas in total: 6 \[Regular Stages] and the newly added \[Finale Stages]. Each stage contains 4 rounds of challenges.
The first stage will open on the day the Version 2.5 update goes live. After that, one new arena will open every Sunday at 13:00 (UTC-7) until all stages are available.
● How to Unlock
Complete the world quest \[Mira Crown Merit Arena: Itzaland] or \[New Start: Mira Crown Merit Arena!] to unlock.
● Event Access
Visit the Stylist's Guild and interact with the Infinity Mirror to enter. Alternatively, you can enter the event via the \[Mira Crown] button in the Pear-Pal interface.
● Event Rules
1. New \[Advanced Stages]

After completing the 4 rounds of \[Challenge Stages] in each Regular Stage, you can inherit blessings and continue challenging the \[Advanced Stages]. Clearing all \[Advanced Stages] will earn the \[Achievement: Echo of the Tide].
◆ \[Advanced Stages] do not affect the acquisition of \[Sunny Shimmer] and \[Dreamlake Ripple] in the Regular Arenas.
2. New \[Finale Stage]

The \[Finale Stage] will unlock after completing the sixth stage. At the start of the challenge, additional blessing effects will be granted based on your progress in the \[Advanced Stages]. Clear it to earn the \[Achievement: Trace the Echo of Return] and \[Title: Conqueror of Miracles].
● Event Rewards

1. Upon completing a challenge, win or lose, you will receive rewards such as \[Sunny Shimmer] and \[Dreamlake Ripple]. Complete arena challenges for the first time to earn additional Revelation Crystals, Resonite Crystals, and growth materials.

2. \[Sunny Shimmer] and \[Dreamlake Ripple] can be used to exchange for rewards in the \[Glow Chamber] store. \[Sunny Shimmer] can be exchanged for Legendary Outfit crafting materials, including \[Dreambloom of Yore], while \[Dreamlake Ripple] can be exchanged for Resonite Crystals and growth materials.

◆ \[Sunny Shimmer] and \[Dreamlake Ripple] have weekly and total collection limits. The amount you can obtain will reset every Monday at 04:00 (server time). Once you reach the weekly or total limit, you will no longer earn these rewards from repeated challenges.

Dear Stylists,

Nikki can use her gun to mark an enemy. The wolf follows with a pursuit attack, dealing increased damage to the marked target. The Moon-Hunting Wolf can launch Nikki into the air, then follow her aim and slam down onto the targeted enemy. When the Moon-Hunting Wolf deals a certain amount of damage on its own, Nikki gains Gunblossom Marks. Using the Companion Skill consumes all Gunblossom Marks to restore an equal amount of Health.

Approach the Moon-Hunting Wolf and use the button to unleash its full power, transforming it into a giant form and entering Co-hunt State, allowing Nikki to control it directly. While in Co-hunt State, the Moon-Hunting Wolf continuously consumes Battle Companion Energy. When depleted, the Co-hunt State ends, and the wolf returns to its small form. When not in Co-hunt State, Battle Companion Energy gradually recovers.

notes.title: How to gain and use Sweet Affection

★ Optimizations ★
■ Photography System Optimizations
● Optimized poses in \[Momo's Camera] and added a new Favorites feature:

Stylists can use the Favorite button in the top-left corner of an action icon in the action selection screen to save that action. Once favorited, poses can be viewed under the Favorites tab, where stylists can quickly select their preferred poses for photo shoots.
● Optimized camera settings in \[Momo's Camera], adding new options, which include \[Focus on Nikki] toggle, \[Focus Distance] setting, and \[Hide Shoes] toggle:
>> \[Focus on Nikki] & \[Focus Distance]
When \[Focus on Nikki] is enabled, the camera will automatically focus on Nikki, and \[Focus Distance] will be locked. When it is disabled, you can manually adjust the focus distance.
◆ After the update, \[Focus on Nikki] will be enabled by default.
\[Hide Shoes]
This toggle appears only in scenes where Nikki's shoes can be hidden. Stylists can switch shoe visibility on or off as needed.

● Improved the photo-taking experience in scenes where the message "Cannot take photos in the current state" would previously appear. After the update, using \[Momo's Camera] in these scenarios will instead open the \[Moment Capturer] interface, allowing you to capture more special moments.
■ Quality-of-Life Improvements for Home
● \[Decor Catalog] Update
After clearing \, \[Mothershroom's Dream], \[Shiny Vault], and \[Sugarbloom Isle], you can unlock and photograph furniture in the \[Decor Catalog].
Furniture from \ and \[Mothershroom's Dream] will be recorded in Itzaland Volume 1, while furniture from \[Shiny Vault] and \[Sugarbloom Isle] will be recorded in Itzaland Volume 2.
● Added new furniture item \[Painting: Gentle Slumber]
You can clear \[Challenge: Sugarbloom Isle] to obtain \[Painting: Gentle Slumber], which can be placed in open areas for display and photography.
● Added new furniture item \[Journey Highlights Display Cabinet]

Stylists with Home Abilities Level 20 or above can exchange for \[Journey Highlights Display Cabinet] at \[Yardling Shop]. After placing it in Home, you can select and display Achievement Badges earned in Stylist Courses.
● Certain decorative items can now be placed in Home
\[Snuggle Puff], \[Bunny Beanbag], and \[Bubbly Bath] can now be placed in open areas in Home for display and photography.
■ Ability Setup & Switching Optimizations
● Added ability category filters to the \[Ability Setup] screen, divided into four categories: Collect, Area, Home, and Inspire. Stylists can filter by category to locate abilities more easily.
● Added a card view display option in the \[Ability Setup] interface, allowing more abilities to be shown at once. Stylists can freely switch between list view and card view.
● The \[Switch Ability] screen now includes Purification-type and Floating-type abilities, making it easier to review wheel presets.
● Added a quick-switch shortcut for Whimsicality abilities. After switching Whimsicality abilities, you can press the shortcut key to open the ability list and quickly select another ability.
■ Main Interface Optimizations
● Improved the dash cooldown indicator: the previous text prompt has been replaced with a flashing button indicator.
● Improved the insufficient Bow Energy notification when using bow skills: instead of a text pop-up, the energy bar and skill button will now flash.

● Added customizable layout options on mobile for certain main interface buttons. Stylists can swap the positions of the "Ring the Starbell" button and "Whim Essence" button, and drag the lower-right button group left or right.
Adjust settings via \[Settings > Custom > Interface Settings > Main Interface Layout].
■ Co-op & Chat Optimizations

● Improved chat visibility during co-op play. While holding hands, conversations with your co-op partner will be pinned to the top of the chat channel, and messages will appear as world chat bubbles in the open world.
● Improved message input when chatting with friends. Unsent messages will now remain in the input field when switching or closing chat windows, until the game is exited.
■ Clothing
● Evolution Stage 2 bonus rewards reissued for the \[Wings of Wishes] Outfit

After the Version 2.3 update, Evolution Stage 2 bonus rewards for the outfit \[Wings of Wishes] will be reissued, including the decoration \[Uncaged Wishes: Radiance] and photo prop \[Wake-Up Stretch]. Stylists who have already evolved the Wings of Wishes outfit to stage 2 can claim these bonus rewards from the \[Clothing Evolution] interface.
● Previous 3-Star Outfits Now Dyeable
After the Version 2.3 update, all previous 3-star outfits will become dyeable. Stylists can head to the Dye interface to start experimenting.
● Previous 5-Star Pieces Now Dyeable

After the Version 2.3 update, the following 5-star pieces will become dyeable and gain new color variations once fully glowed up: \[Guardian's Vow], \[Sanctified Love], \[Echoing Plumes], \[Diverse Trend], \[Pink Declaration], \[Breezy Message], \[Soft Poems], \[Gilded Past], \[Berry Secrets], \[Old Ideals], \[Revisiting Old Words], \[Delicate Openwork], \[Twin Ruby], \[Replenished Vitality], \[Bug Commander], \[Midday Sun], \[Sweet Metal], and \[Sunlight Praise].
◆ More previous pieces will gradually become dyeable in future updates. Please stay tuned.
■ Others

● Added new feeding item \[Sugarbloom Snailfruit] to the Snail Feeding feature. Healthy snails that consume this item will temporarily change shell appearance, reverting to their original form daily at 04:00.
● Improved teleportation when using the slide in \[Spira – Spin Slide], allowing the sliding animation to continue seamlessly.

● Improved the reading experience for readable items during story dialogue: Graphic and textual readable items introduced in Version 2.3 and later will now use a new display layout that prevents overlap with dialogue boxes. Stylists can also use a button to view these in full screen. A new review button has been added to History, allowing stylists to revisit previously viewed reading materials.
● Improved the bell-ringing feature. Stylists can now ring the Starbell while jumping, floating, or using vehicles such as bicycles.
● Added new audio adjustment options under \[Settings > Audio]: \[UI Sound Effects] and \[Skill Sound Effects] volume sliders.
● Added \ to the Feature Collection list. Using this feature will revive Nikki at the nearest Warp Spire to the stuck location.
● Optimized sorting behavior in \[Glow Up]. Custom sorting settings will no longer reset when reopening the interface or restarting the game.

● Adjusted button interactions on PS5 for improved precision. In interfaces such as Backpack, Shop, and Wardrobe, the D-pad can now be used for more accurate selection. The Store currency shortcut has been reassigned to \, among other adjustments.
● Optimized the reward collection experience in Mira Journey. Stylists can now claim task rewards even after reaching the maximum Journey Level.
● Improved the display of \ in the Sanctum of the Observant. Portfolios are now organized by region, and each page displays up to 4 entries.
● Optimized red-dot notifications for \[Mira Crown Merit Arena] and \.
● Improved navigation bar displays on certain PC and PS interfaces.

In order to provide a better gaming experience, we've recently implemented optimizations, adjustments, and bug fixes to the game. Thank you for your understanding and support. We wish you a pleasant journey in Miraland!
★Fixed Issues & Optimizations★
■ January 29, 2026 Updates
★ Optimizations ★
■ Home

● After the Version 2.2 update, the following animals in Itzaland and the Wanxiang Realm can be invited to your Homeland using the Animal Inviting ability: Night Heron Wanderer, Masquerade Lynx, Looptail Pika, Brush Beaver, Shawl Deer, Heritage Wing, Nightglow Wolf, Skirt Tail, Wind Glider, Scholar Owl, Honeybunny, Terra Floof, and Rougewings.

● Adjusted the construction load of certain high-load purple and pink quality furniture. After the update, the load value of these pieces will be reduced to 75%–85% of their previous values.

■ Momo's Camera and Momo's Album Enhancements

● Added a new Collage Poster feature to Momo's Album. Stylists can use collage assets along with photos taken with Momo's Camera to create unique compositions. Capture scenic landscapes and joyful moments—every beautiful memory deserves to be treasured. With this update, five free collage assets will be available in the \[Collage Poster] feature, and stylists can earn two additional assets by participating in the current event.

● Added a new Framed Moment feature to Momo's Camera. After obtaining Framed Moment resources, stylists can quickly set up camera angles and poses for shooting. Whether it's a light, spontaneous pose or a beautifully timed moment, this feature helps turn your photos into unique expressions of the moment.

After the Version 2.2 update, new handheld items for ability outfits will be issued, including: \[Azure Water], \[Echoing Ripples], and \[Sparkling Ripples] of the \[Rippling Serenity] outfit; \[Flower Web], \[Tracing Green], and \[Field Whispers] of the \[Afternoon Shine] outfit; \[Puffy Freshness], \[Puffy Fur], \[Spotless Radiance], of the \[Bye-Bye Dust] outfit; \[Bloom Whisper] of the \[Spring Blossom] outfit; \[Canvas of Ideas] of the \[Flawless Vision] outfit. ★ New Content ★
■ New Region: Wanxiang Realm

Permanently available after the Version 2.2 update. Deep within Linlang's sea of clouds lies a mysterious realm, home to a clan whose faces bear natural, colorful markings—the Chromafaces. Here, the bright moon hangs eternally, and lantern light never fades. For countless centuries, and for reasons unknown, the realm has seemed frozen in a single, endless day, immersed in an unending festival.
● Cai Ye

The city hums with life, and lanterns glow without end. Amid shifting lights and shadows, laughter fills every street, while the Chromafaces weave a dazzling tapestry of dreams, lost in the endless variety of the festival.
● Kongming Gorge

Venture into a hidden valley where sound fades, and cliffs loom high. Even the Chromafaces give this place a wide berth, leaving only the wind to whisper through the jagged rocks, hinting at secrets long buried.
● Jiuhua Pavilion

Stylists can explore Jiuhua Pavilion after completing Chapter Two of the "Where Wanxiang Weaves Life" exclusive quest. The pavilion stands among the stars and neighbors the moon. Heavenly music and joyous feasts fill its halls, but its drapes hide great sorrow.
● Land of Eternal Daylight
Hidden within Jiuhua Pavilion lies the Land of Eternal Daylight, where rests the origin and final home of every illusion, safeguarding stories long forgotten...
● New Ability Outfit for the Region

The Ability Outfit \[Nefarious Shadows] can be acquired in the Heart of Infinity, which provides the Shadow-Shatter ability. When Nikki uses the Shadow-Shatter ability, she creates a Shadow-Shatter Field centered on herself. Shadow Esselings within the field will reveal their true forms and behave according to their usual habits for a period of time. By skillfully using the Shadow-Shatter ability to reveal the true forms of Disguised Shadows, you can unlock new paths and explore deeper into the Wanxiang Realm.
● Exploration Rewards for the New Region

Explore the Wanxiang Realm to obtain \[Whim Lanterns] and \[Wanxiang Bells], which can be shared with Buzzy of the Wanxiang Realm in exchange for gifts, including \, Furniture Sketches, dyeing items, and growth materials.
● New Bow
Progress through the exclusive quest "Where Wanxiang Weaves Life" to obtain the bow \[Hunting Shadows].
>> Whim Combat Skill: Whirling Hunt

Holding the Skill Button activates Hunting Mode, during which Nikki continuously loses Health (max 4 points) to automatically search for hunting targets. Targets can be tracked multiple times. Release the Skill Button to exit Hunting Mode. Scarlet Rain arrows will strike all hunted targets, deal continuous AoE damage, increase the number of times targets are hunted, and extend the duration of the AoE damage. If there are no hunting targets within range, Nikki can consume 1 point of Health to deal large AoE damage in front of her.
>> Whim Combat Skill: Shadow's Return

The skill consumes Bow Energy to rapidly fire Healing Arrows. Each time an arrow hits an Esseling, Nikki restores 1 point of Health. Activating the Skill Button repeatedly to quickly fire consecutive Healing Arrows.
>> Base Effect: Crimson Hunt
When Nikki's Health is low, Bow Energy restores faster.

■ "Life as a Poem" Exclusive Quest Details

The Frostbough Behemoth falls into a long slumber in the silent forest as goodbyes and new births weave the poetry of life. ■ "Behemoth Guardian Project" Permanent Gameplay Feature

Available permanently after the Version 2.1 update, this feature unlocks after the exclusive quest "Life as a Poem" is completed. Stylists can visit Warmfur Home, located in the northern part of the Forest of Slumber, to experience it.

You can observe your Behemoth fawnling's monthly growth and attribute progress in real time. Interactions such as dressing, feeding, and head pats will help build Affinity. By reaching goals, you can collect \[Growth Marks] and generous rewards from the Growth Milestones, Warmfur Wishes, and Forest Tales features. These \[Growth Marks] can be spent at the Memory Shop to purchase fun toys, Flavor Essence, Behemoth Dress-Up items, and more.
>> Daily Schedule

During each month of growth, you can arrange \[Growth Events] for the four attributes—Strength, Intellect, Emotion, and Curiosity, along with \[Companion Events]. As you continue raising your Behemoth fawnling, more \[Growth Events] and \[Companion Events] will become available. Completing events grants attribute points and Affinity. From random stories triggered during events to stage-based stories unlocked as your Behemoth fawnling grows, each moment becomes a unique memory you share. When your Behemoth fawnling's upbringing comes to an end, its attributes will determine the outcome. Some endings may even result in physical changes.
>> Warmfur Home Facilities
Head to the \[Construction Board] inside Warmfur Home to unlock and build different facilities once conditions are met:
\[Cozy Den] and \[Bath Tub] allow your Behemoth fawnling to restore energy and mood; resting or bathing may occasionally grant extra Affinity.
Play facilities such as \[Swaying Ball], \[Wobbly Pot], \[Low Climbing Frame], and \[Holed Stump] can help your Behemoth fawnling exercise and raise different ability levels.
You can summon your current Behemoth Fawnling by playing the recorder, letting it explore nearby facilities.
>> Ending Rewards

After living through its juvenile period at Warmfur Home, your Behemoth fawnling will reach its growth ending. Depending on the path you choose, there are 35 different endings to unlock. When your Behemoth fawnling's upbringing concludes, exclusive gifts will be unlocked based on Affinity level, including Headwear \[Soft Sprout], Top \[Damp Fur], Trousers \[Puff Tail], and Shoes \[Shallow Bay]. You will also receive accumulated \[Growth Marks]. When Affinity reaches a certain level, you will obtain \[Title: Head of Warmfur Home].
◆ Gifts include clothing pieces and their sketches.
>> Quick Growth Mode

Each time you finish raising your current Behemoth fawnling and unlock its ending, play the recorder again at the entrance of \[Warmfur Home] to welcome a new companion. Stylists with previous raising experience can allocate the new fawnling's starting talent points and select the Quick Growth to witness the fawnling reach adulthood in less time.

★ Optimizations ★
■ "Star Crystal Tree" Optimization
● Map Display Optimization for "Star Crystal Tree"

A new icon has been added to the map to indicate the location of the "Star Crystal Tree." When the \[Starlit Crystals] on the tree reach their maximum capacity, a notification will appear in the lower-left corner of the map.
■ Animal Gameplay Optimizations in Home
● Cooking: \[Animal Food]

A new category of dessert food, \[animal food], has been added to the Cooking feature, including \[Handmade Cookies], \[Secret-Recipe Cookies], and \[Signature Cookies]. When your Cooking ability reaches levels 4, 7, and 9, you will unlock one low-level, medium-level, and high-level animal food recipe, respectively. The food created through Cooking can be fed to animals in the \[Animal Lodge] on the "Host Animal" page. After eating, the animals will receive an increased yield of special products.
● Added \[Switch Feeding Mode] in the \[Animal Hosting] feature

A new \[Switch Feeding Mode] option has been added to the \[Host Animal] page, allowing stylists to change feeding modes. A new \[Leisure & Abundance] mode is also available. Under this mode, animals will eat at a healthy, slower pace and receive a bonus to special product yields.
● "Animal Inviting" Optimizations

Optimized the "Animal Inviting" feature. When the Animal Inviting ability is used in the open world to listen to the animals' songs, if the target animal has not yet reached the required level to unlock the invitation, a level requirement notification will appear.
The Animal Inviting interface within Home has been optimized, allowing the occupancy numbers of different Animal Lodges to be displayed.
Animal Affection feedback has also been optimized. When an animal's affection level increases, the affection gained will now be clearly displayed.
■ Clothing System Optimizations
● New Handheld Items for Ability Outfits

After the update on January 6 (UTC-7), new handheld items for ability outfits will be issued, including: \[Verdant Tambourine] of the \[Verdant Verse] outfit, \[Forest Dreamweb] of the \[Sweet Waltz] outfit, \[Devout Chime] of the \[Silent Ode] outfit, \[Heart Rainbow] of the \[Purifying Wind] outfit, as well as \[Shroomling's Zephyr] and \[Shadow Bow]. After the update, stylists who have completed a full set can claim their corresponding rewards at \[Outfit Compendium].
◆ Note: \[Shroomling's Zephyr] and \[Shadow Bow] can be claimed via the \[Purifying Wind] outfit's \[Outfit Compendium] collection rewards.

The new handheld items for ability outfits in Version 2.1 can be dyed. In addition, all the handheld items introduced in Version 2.0 can also be dyed, including: \[Radiant Cage] of the \[Behind Prayers] outfit, \[Immaculate Blessing] of the \[Enchanted Encounter] outfit, \[Final Chant] of the \[Nameless, Selfless] outfit, \[Path of Blossoms] of the \[Stardust Flare] outfit, and \[Snowy Branch] of the \[Crystal Poems] outfit.
◆ Note: Dye effects on handheld items for ability outfits will only appear in visual displays and will not be visible during actual ability use.

In Version 2.1, new 4-star and 3-star pieces can be dyed. Additionally, 4-star pieces will unlock new color variations after being fully glowed up.
◆ In future updates, more past 4-star and 3-star pieces will gradually become dyeable, and new color variations for fully glowed up 4-star pieces will be added. Stay tuned.
● Dye Interface Optimization

A new quick-jump feature has been added to the Dye interface. Stylists can use the button under the Dyeing Scheme bar to expand the list of outfit pieces for fast switching. Selecting a specific piece will take you directly to its Dye interface.
● Wardrobe Interface: Tab Optimization

A new \[Body Paint] category has been added under the \ tab in the Wardrobe interface. Several existing accessory pieces have been reclassified under this category, including: \[Windswept Plume], \[Windswept Plume: Unbloomed], \[Ray of Light], \[Scars of Bone], and \[Void of Life]. Stylists can view these pieces under \ > \[Body Paint].
● \[Change Details] Feature Optimization
Some outfit descriptions have been updated with a \[Details of the piece can be changed] tag.
The Wardrobe interface has been optimized with a quick details-switch button, allowing stylists to easily toggle between different details within the same outfit.

The outfit filter interface has also been improved: a new \[Details of the piece can be changed] filter option has been added under \, enabling stylists to quickly find outfit pieces with alternative details.
